predicted_outcome.description: Simulation result if this option is chosen

mechanism: A discrete, actionable alternative within a decision space. An Option must be fully specified (executable) and mutually exclusive from other options in the same set. It represents a valid path for state transition.
invariants: Fully specified: an Option is executable as written, not a direction requiring further choice.
Mutually exclusive: selecting one Option in a set excludes the others in that set.
